validation.notes: Repaired three independent defects on the trust decision chain: project-trust.ts now denies (returns false) instead of granting trust when the ask policy cannot be answered with no UI; settings-manager.ts setProjectTrusted(false) now discards the cached project settings ({}) instead of the no-op self-assignment, so merged getters immediately fall back to global values; resource-loader.ts now applies the resolved decision (setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted)) instead of forcing true, so a revocation drops project settings and project extensions from the next resolved set while the bootstrap pass still forces untrusted and resolver-less reloads retain the existing trust state. The regression script links the real submitted modules through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (only settings storage, package manager, extension/trust-store and UI boundaries faked) and asserts cross-module behaviour: headless ask-policy denial with no stored decision and no consent write, stored-decision and UI approval paths, approval exposing project settings/extensions, resolver-less reload retaining trust, revocation clearing the project settings cache and resolving CLI+global extensions only with the stored project settings file untouched, and immediate clearing when setProjectTrusted(false) is called directly. Validation evidence: run exits 0 with all assertions passing; restoring each source file alone to its faulty baseline makes the same script exit non-zero via a real AssertionError (project-trust: 'headless ask-policy resolution without a stored decision must deny'; settings-manager: 'setProjectTrusted(false) must clear cached project settings'; resource-loader: 'headless denial must leave the project untrusted'), never via import error, crash or timeout. Limitation: the repository vitest suites (packages/coding-agent/test/settings-manager.test.ts and test/resource-loader.test.ts) were not executed because node_modules is not installed in the workspace; no dependencies were installed and no external services, timers or randomness are used. Test inputs live under .prale-eval/ and are removed on exit.
